description: This file defines a repository class for managing filter segments in a data table, including CRUD operations and user preferences, with database interactions via Prisma ORM.

classes.name: FilterSegmentRepository
classes.description: Implements methods to manage filter segments including retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and user preference setting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves filter segments for a user and their associated preferences, including scope filtering and parsing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new filter segment with validation for scope and permissions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing filter segment after permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a filter segment after permission validation.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets or clears user filter segment preferences.
